text.en:
The following appropriations are hereby made, to be added to those made for the Bureau of
Commerce and Industry by sections 1-QQ-100, 101, 102, 103, 126, and 129 of Act Numbered Twenty-eight
hundred and seventy-five, for the operation and maintenance of the steamship Tablas:
SALARIES AND WAGES.
Officers, at rates and subject to conditions to be fixed by agreement between the Secretaries of the Interior,
Finance, and Commerce and Communications, in proportion to those granted by private shipowners for
similar services . .. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . P12,880.00
Petty officers and crew, at rates and subject to conditions to be fixed by agreement between the Secretaries of
the Interior, Finance, and Commerce and Communications, in proportion to those granted by private
shipowners for similar services . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 14, 190.00
Clothing allowance to crew . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .1,030,00
Subsistence of officers, petty officers, and crew, at rates and subject to conditions to be fixed by agreement
between the Secretaries of the Interior, Finance, and Commerce and Communications, in proportion to those
granted by private shipowners for similar services . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
13,850,00
Total for salaries and wages . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .41,950.00
MISCELLANEOUS EXPENSES.
Consumption of supplies and materials . . . . . , P68,050.00
Maintenance and repair of equipment . . . . . . . . . 30,000.00
Total for miscellaneous expenses . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 98,050.00
RECAPITULATION.
Total for salaries and wages . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 41,950.00
Total for miscellaneous expenses . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 98,050.00
Total of additional appropriations for the Bureau of Commerce and Industry . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .140,000.00
Provided,That in the discretion of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications, the steamship Tablas

may be used by the Bureau of Labor, without any expense to the latter, for its activities in connection with
inter-island migration.
